from.installedBy: adb install of the versioned asset after checking frame.apk.sha256

to.installedBy: the in-app updater and the Android package installer

checks: First launch of 0.2.0 offered 0.2.1 (3.5 MB) from the live frame-app manifest.
Download completed and verified in under two seconds; the banner offered Install and promised the draft and remembered frames are kept.
Install opened Android's Install unknown apps page; leaving without allowing returned to a usable app that kept the verified download and explained the permission.
After allowing the source, Install handed off to the Android installer, which scanned the package with Google Play Protect and replaced the app.
0.2.1 (build 2001) reopened with the same signer, the frame reconnected, and the draft kept 2048.png with Brightness 75.
The banner disappeared, Settings showed Sparkle Duck 0.2.1 (build 2001), and a manual check reported the latest version.
notExercised: First install from the download link in the phone's browser.
Cancelling the Android installer dialog itself.
Interrupting a download; 3.5 MB finishes too quickly on WiFi.
Metadata with a wrong checksum or a different signing digest from a test build.
Deferral behind an active display refresh.
observations: Google Play Protect scans every sideloaded install or update before the installer confirms it.
During the resume reconnect after Android Settings, the banner briefly disabled Install with the busy message, then offered it again once the frame connected.
The permission notice told the user to tap Install update although the button is labelled Install.
